dt-api.name: stateRestore.states()

type.parameter: An array of values that are used to identify the desired states. If no value is given, all states are selected.
type.description: Retrieves stored states from the StateRestore extension.
type.returns: Returns a DataTables API instance for the states selected.

dt-api.description:
This method provides the ability to selected states that are managed by the StateRestore extension for further manipulation by chained methods.
The state selector is an array of values that will match against the `id` property of the `-type StateRestore.State` object. If no selector is provided, then all states will automatically be selected.

example.title: Select two states by a given id
